guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 注册 Kash 应用账户
guide.description: 打开 Kash 应用，关联 X 账号并确认用于恢复账户的邮箱。由于交易通过回复帖子进行，请使用自己发帖的账号。完善个人资料可获得首批 50 XP。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Sign Up on the Kash App
guide.original_description: Go to the Kash app , connect your X account, and confirm a recovery email. Use the account you post from, since trades run through replies. Completing your profile earns your first 50 XP.

guide.title: 在 Base 网络为钱包准备 USDC
guide.description: 注册时，Kash 会创建一个由自己保管的 Privy 钱包，无需管理助记词。可通过连接已有钱包、直接充值加密资产，或使用银行卡、Apple Pay 为其充值。原文提供了在 Bybit 购买 USDC 的选项；如果资金位于其他链，可通过来源页面下方的组件跨链或兑换到 Base。原文还包含跨链组件宣传：支持 30 多条链，宣称路由快速、费用较低；点击立即跨链（Bridge now）打开组件，也可在新标签页打开。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Fund Your Wallet With USDC on Base
guide.original_description: Kash creates a self-custody Privy wallet for you on sign-up, with no seed phrase to manage. Top it up by connecting an existing wallet, depositing crypto directly, or using a card or Apple Pay. You can buy USDC on Bybit , and if your funds sit on another chain, the widget below can bridge or swap them to Base. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

guide.title: 寻找活跃市场
guide.description: 市场信息会出现在 X 信息流中，来源包括 Kash 账号、创作者账号和合作方账号。选择自己对结果有明确判断的市场。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Markets appear in your feed from the Kash account on X, creator accounts, and partner accounts. Pick ones where you have an actual read on the outcome.

guide.title: 从信息流下单交易
guide.description: 回复或引用转发市场帖子，注明选择方向和金额，并标记发布该市场的账号：Kash 市场标记 @kash_bot_trades，例如发送“@kash_bot_trades YES 50”；创作者市场标记该创作者账号；合作方市场标记该合作方账号。示例中的 YES 是操作指令，需要保留英文。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Place a Trade From Your Feed
guide.original_description: Reply to or quote-post the market with your side and amount, tagging the account that launched it: Kash market : tag @kash_bot_trades, for example “@kash_bot_trades YES 50” Creator market : tag that creator’s account Partner market : tag the partner’s handle

guide.title: 直接在应用内交易
guide.description: 如果不想发帖，可在 Kash 应用中打开一个市场，选择是（YES）或否（NO），设置仓位大小后确认。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: If you prefer not to post, open a market in the Kash app , choose YES or NO, set your size, and confirm.

guide.title: 持有仓位至市场结算并领取奖励
guide.description: 只有金额至少为 10 美元且一直持有到市场结算的预测仓位，才计入 XP、交易量、连续记录及准确率。市场结算后，从账户余额中领取奖励。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Hold Positions to Resolution and Claim Winnings
guide.original_description: Only calls of $10 or more held until the market resolves count toward XP, volume, streaks, and accuracy. Claim winnings from your balance once a market settles.

guide.title: 邀请持续活跃的交易者
guide.description: 从应用分享个人邀请链接。当朋友完成总额 50 美元、且持有至市场结算的交易后，该邀请才计入；每周奖励池加成对应被邀请者最终取得的排名。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Share your referral link from the app. A referral counts once your friend trades $50 to resolution, and your weekly pool bonus mirrors the rank your referee finishes at.

faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。

sourcedDescription: Kash’s documentation reserves 25% of the total KASH supply for community incentives, paid out for trading accuracy, market creation, liquidity provision, and referrals. A TGE date and the exact token distribution method have not been announced, so XP and leaderboard activity are the best available signals for a future allocation.
